mapper.select: SELECT duo.dates, duo.pkg, duo.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.config_group_id, IFNULL(sum(duo.online_time), 0) total_online_time, IFNULL(sum(duo.online_time) / count(DISTINCT duo.user_id), 0) avg_user_online_time, IFNULL(sum(case when dui.user_id is not null then duo.online_time end), 0) new_user_online_time, IFNULL(sum(duo.online_time) / count(DISTINCT dui.user_id), 0) avg_new_user_online_time FROM dwd_user_online duo INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (duo.user_id = dui.user_id and dui.dates = duo.dates) INNER JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.user_id = duo.user_id) where duo.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY duo.dates, duo.pkg, duo.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.config_group_id
